Litecoin explorer documentation
Blocks, transactions and addresses

Search a block height, block hash, transaction ID, transparent Litecoin address, or supported explorer URL. A 64-character hash may belong to several chains; manual chain selection stays available.

Litecoin targets one block every 2.5 minutes. Difficulty adjusts every 2,016 blocks. The block subsidy halves every 840,000 blocks.

1 LTC = 100,000,000 litoshis. Fee rates use lit/vB. Fiat values use the provider's Litecoin prices and may lag the market.

Privacy and coverage

The transaction and address views show the transparent chain. MWEB hides transfer amounts and recipient history; a public explorer cannot reconstruct these private details. HogEx and peg-in/peg-out data must not be interpreted as ordinary wallet transfers.

The pending view is Litecoin Space's node mempool, not a universal global pool. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

Read-only API

Requests use the same local origin. Successful retained responses carry X-LTC-Observed-At and X-LTC-Stale headers. Provider failures return 503; absence returns 404. This local review does not broadcast transactions.

ltc.tx.taxi - Litecoin block and mempool explorer
A tx.taxi explorer built from mempool/mempool
About ltc.tx.taxi

ltc.tx.taxi is the Litecoin explorer in the tx.taxi multi-chain family. It preserves Mempool's proven interface for inspecting blocks, transactions, addresses, mining activity, fee estimates, and the live Litecoin mempool while using a Litecoin-specific tx.taxi identity.

Bitcoin-native data

Values are denominated in LTC, litoshis, or the selected fiat currency. Fee rates remain lit/vB, transaction sizes remain vB or weight units, and all block, address, mining, concepts shown by the interface retain their Litecoin meaning.

MWEB coverage

This explorer shows transparent-chain transactions and indexed addresses. Private MWEB amounts and recipient history are not publicly observable. HogEx transactions connect the extension block to the transparent chain.

Infrastructure

The explorer reads public Litecoin network data through its configured backend. Explorer results are informational and can differ from another node's view of the mempool. Always verify payment details in your wallet and use your own node when independent verification matters.

License

ltc.tx.taxi incorporates licensed open-source components. See the third-party license notices for attribution details.

Privacy Policy
Updated: September 20, 2026



Use Your Own Node When Privacy Matters

ltc.tx.taxi displays public Litecoin chain and mempool data through the backend configured by the site operator. For independent verification and the strongest network privacy, use your own Litecoin node and explorer.



Request Data

Normal website and API requests can reveal standard web metadata to the operator, including your IP address, user agent, requested URL, and request time. Server logs may be retained for reliability, abuse prevention, and debugging.



Local Preferences

Display preferences such as theme, denomination, fiat currency, language, and timezone may be stored in your browser. ltc.tx.taxi does not require an account for ordinary explorer use.



Public Blockchain Data

Litecoin transactions, addresses, scripts, and blocks are public. Looking up an address or transaction can associate that lookup with your network metadata. Do not treat a public explorer as a privacy boundary.



External Links

This site links to tx.taxi contact channels, Litecoin documentation, upstream source code, and license information. Those external services have their own privacy policies.
